A370261.name: a(n) = sqrt(A370259(2*n)/(n+1)) for n >= 1.
comment: The sequence is conjectured to be integral.
formula: a(n) = sqrt( (T(2*n, 2*n+1) - 1)/((n+1)*(2*n)^3) ), where T(n, x) is the n-th Chebyshev polynomial of the first kind.
A370261.author: _Peter Bala_, Mar 11 2024

A370259.name: a(n) = (T(n,n+1) - 1)/n^3 for n >= 1, where T(n,x) is the n-th Chebyshev polynomial of the first kind.
comment: It appears that a(2*n+1) is always a square, while a(2*n) = (n + 1) * a square. See A370260 and A370261.
formula: a(n) = Sum_{k = 1..n} (2^k)*n^(k-2)*binomial(n+k, 2*k)/(n + k) (shows that a(n) is an integer).
A370259.author: _Peter Bala_, Mar 11 2024
